mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE increase > 0.5% does not correlate with subsequent economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter signals a contraction in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or GDPC1 QoQ < -1% does not correlate with subsequent economic contraction.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1 million units and real GDP (GDPC1) growth is negative, it signals a significant demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST < 1 million units AND GDPC1 QoQ < 0%
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of HOUST < 1 million units and GDPC1 QoQ < 0% does not correlate with subsequent demand contraction.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 7% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) decreases for two consecutive months, it signals a labor market downturn, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 7% AND PAYEMS decreases for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of UNRATE > 7% and PAYEMS decreases does not correlate with subsequent labor market weakness.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the real GDP (GDPC1) growth is negative, it signals a restrictive monetary policy in a contracting economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of FEDFUNDS > 4% and GDPC1 QoQ < 0% does not correlate with subsequent economic contraction.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in retail sales (RSAFS) signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
